definitions.cutoffs: America/New_York; complete 5-minute bars [start,end); 04:00 condition uses 03:55 candle close; final session close is last included candle close.
definitions.stalled: After any strict high/low breach, final close outside the forecast but at most 10%/15% of full forecast width beyond nearest boundary. Inside closes are a separate category. This is an endpoint tolerance, not proof price stalled throughout.
definitions.occupancy: Every completed close above/below actual window decision open; unchanged separately. Dominant side compares U and D counts. U90/D90 require >=90% of ALL closes, unchanged included in denominator.
definitions.rangeMultiple: 1 + extension/full width; 1.2 means 20% beyond breached boundary. Not statistical standard deviation.
definitions.avr: Cumulative high-low from previous calendar 19:30 to cutoff / frozen same-contract 10-day NY AVR. At03:00/05:00/08:30 include that already-known opening price, matching the input table. Other range rulers use completed bars;16:00 target excludes the16:00 candle. Additional expansion is increase in cumulative range, including zero.
definitions.bbox: Previous complete GC NY range from the frozen BBOX protocol. Full-history pre03 observation is limited to19:30–03; native sensitivity covers prior16:00–03. GC uses only last complete same-contract prior NY references under the frozen GC protocol. No shortened-session substitution.
definitions.predictive: Saved forecast boundaries reconstructed with all-years matches, not historical as-known forecasts. Direction studies use actual opening anchors and past-known occupancy; chronological evaluation reserves first250 eligible dates for warmup, then earlier-only empirical probabilities with20 prior-day equivalents of shrinkage. Retrospective GC replication; chronological evaluation is not a prospective holdout.
definitions.uncertainty: Tables use unadjusted Wilson95 intervals for per-day proportions; serial dependence may narrow them. Prediction-loss differences use1000 circular10-day-block bootstrap replicates. Many exploratory combinations; no multiple-testing correction.
definitions.combinations: Five disjoint AVR bins plus +/-5pp landmark bands. Show all25 two-cutoff and125 three-cutoff bin combinations including empty/impossible cells. Extreme directional joint matrix has25 cells plus9 simple cells.
